mapper.select:
SELECT /* getCommCodeList */ P.COMM_CODE , P.CODE_NAME , P.CODE_EXPL , P.USEE_YSNO , P.USEE_YSNO_NAME , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , P.UPDT_DATE FROM ( SELECT R.COMM_CODE , R.CODE_NAME , R.CODE_EXPL , R.USEE_YSNO , R.USEE_YSNO_NAME , R.REGI_ADMN , R.REGI_ADMN_NAME , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_ADMN , R.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , R.UPDT_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.COMM_CODE) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT C.COMM_CODE , C.CODE_NAME , C.CODE_EXPL , C.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, C.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , C.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , C.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_CODEXM C WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.COMM_CODE ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getCommCodeListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_CODEXM C WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getCommCodeDtl */ COMM_CODE , CODE_NAME , CODE_EXPL , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE FROM TM_CODEXM WHERE COMM_CODE = #{commCode}
SELECT /* getCommCodeCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_CODEXM WHERE COMM_CODE = #{commCode}

SELECT /* getCodeList */ COMM_CODE , COMD_CODE , COMD_NAME , COMD_ENNM , CODE_EXPL , UPPR_CODE , OPT1_CODE , OPT1_NAME , OPT1_ENNM , OPT2_CODE , OPT2_NAME , OPT2_ENNM , OPT3_CODE , OPT3_NAME , OPT3_ENNM , OPT4_CODE , OPT4_NAME , OPT4_ENNM , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE , SORT_ORDR FROM TB_CODEXD WHERE COMM_CODE = #{commCode} ORDER BY COALESCE(UPPR_CODE, ''), COALESCE(SORT_ORDR, 9999), COMD_CODE

SELECT /* getCodeDtl */ COMM_CODE , COMD_CODE , COMD_NAME , COMD_ENNM , CODE_EXPL , UPPR_CODE , OPT1_CODE , OPT1_NAME , OPT1_ENNM , OPT2_CODE , OPT2_NAME , OPT2_ENNM , OPT3_CODE , OPT3_NAME , OPT3_ENNM , OPT4_CODE , OPT4_NAME , OPT4_ENNM , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE , SORT_ORDR FROM TB_CODEXD WHERE COMM_CODE = #{commCode} AND COMD_CODE = #{comdCode}

WITH RECURSIVE DESCENDANT AS ( SELECT /* getDescendantCodeCnt */ COMM_CODE , COMD_CODE FROM TB_CODEXD WHERE COMM_CODE = #{commCode} AND UPPR_CODE = #{comdCode} UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.COMM_CODE , CHILD.COMD_CODE FROM TB_CODEXD CHILD INNER JOIN DESCENDANT PARENT ON PARENT.COMM_CODE = CHILD.COMM_CODE AND PARENT.COMD_CODE = CHILD.UPPR_CODE ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DESCENDANT WHERE COMD_CODE = #{candidateCode}
